title: Pyne Pod 2in1 Blue Raspberry Lemonade Prefilled Vape Pods - Pod Salt Edition
description: This Blue Raspberry Lemonade Pod Pack for the Pyne Pod 2-in-1 Kit brings together tart berry sweetness and bright citrus fizz in a flavour that’s both punchy and playful. Blue Raspberry leads with juicy, tangy depth, while the Lemonade element adds a crisp citrus sparkle that lifts the whole blend. It’s a lively, layered vape that delivers refreshment in every puff. Each 2ml pod is prefilled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid and made exclusively for use with the Pyne Pod 2-in-1 device. The pods fit securely via magnetic connection and pair seamlessly with the twist-to-switch dual pod system. With two pods per pack, Blue Raspberry Lemonade offers a sharp and effervescent flavour that complements fruity or menthol pairings.
